title: make_svc.call(peer_addr) in TLS loop needs comment
description: In main.rs lines 128-136, the TLS accept loop calls make_svc.call(peer_addr) before serving the connection. The purpose is to inject ConnectInfo<SocketAddr> so axum extractors can retrieve the peer address (needed for WhoIs auth). Without a comment, the indirection looks mysterious — it is not obvious why we call the service factory with the address rather than simply calling serve_connection directly. A one-line comment explaining the ConnectInfo injection would make this navigable without needing to know axum internals.
